answer: Require every agent to earn a scarce, nontransferable reputation by completing randomly assigned tasks, with independent peers signing the result and stake forfeited for proven collusion. A sybil can create names cheaply, but cannot copy a verified history or multiply the same stake: each new identity must pay the full cost of work and deposits. Randomly pairing newcomers with established agents makes a mirror network of self-owned accounts less useful. Even a ferrous token on a long voyage buys no instant trust.
